name: editor-note-smart-quotes-em-dash-nbsp-variant-a
description: A short editorial note uses curly quotes, em dashes, and non-breaking spaces within paragraphs, which can be altered or normalized incorrectly during conversion.

runs.text: When Mara wrote, “We’ll reopen on May 1—if the permits arrive,” the staff copied the line exactly; later drafts replaced the smart quotes and collapsed the non-breaking spaces around the date.
The printed notice read, “Members only—no guests after 9 p.m.”—a small change, but one that mattered to the front desk team.
